text: I like the game itself. I like the recipe, dice and puzzle sections, but the dice game now has fewer rewards. The videos and spider's lair detract from the game. The videos drone on while the player is held hostage. The spiders lair goes through a long restart every time a round is lost. Three consecutive ads is too many. I don't like that the next round opens automatically before you get a chance to look at your rewards. There are places when a card turns over and the screen changes too fast.

Would give more stars if the developers would actually read these reviews and fix the issues. Pop-ups...where do I start? The amount is insane. I was enjoying this game until I kept getting stuck on levels and having to replay them over and over. yeah, use the extra 5 cards...then you're out of gold. The crops could easily be cut down (level wise). Face it, if you really want to play this game get ready to spend alot of money, time and aggrevation! Games are supposed to be fun not stessful!!

I love this game and have been playing it for 5yrs BUT recently, which has become aggravating, the amount of pop ups to buy things is too much. Also, you start a build or a pet or a mini game and BOOM gone! Can't you just keep something and let us finish it? I know the pet is so many days but there is absolutely no way, unless you spend a good fortune, you can get to the end of stage 5. The constant changes like that and the pop ups every start of the game and new level is frustrating.

I'm giving this game 2 stars only because it does have potential to be a great game, but it's clearly set up to part players from their money. Unless, I made purchases while playing this game (which I'd always blow right through), I found it to be just a losing proposition (I like a bit of a challenge, but come on!). And unless I made purchases, I was only able to play, maybe, 1 or 2 games at a time, which would result in losses a good majority of the time. That's not what I call, enjoyable.

Honestly it's a money grab game. As you advance in the game, it costs more to play, but the rewards you win don't increase. But hey, most games are pay to play so I still enjoy it for what it is. Edit: Yea I enjoyed it for what it was but they got too greedy, changed the stakes. Now I'm gonna use up all my coins and uninstall. It's definitely a high risk extremely low reward game.

I like this game. The thing I want most for it is a storage for all the set decorations. I Hate that they disappear as soon as you replace them! and in order to complete the next set you are forced to replace them! PLEASE make a storage so we can keep the items we EARNED AND ENJOY. then we can choose for ourselves what we want to display, and still get to earn the sets without losing our favorites! also please make the forever pets easier to acquire! still haven't earned even 1.

I play this game all the time. There seems to be a commonality in the reviews. If you have alot of coins, say 1m+ you are on a roll and winning. As soon as you lose, you lose one round 10x over. Then all the pop ups start with the game conning you into spending more money so you will have a better chance at winning with "more rewards". This game has become very frustrating! It needs fixed. Stop making all the extra rewards so expensive and internal reward games hard to win.

Edit: initially rated 1 ⭐ but as I got farther, it got easier. Some advice to the developers; don't make the first 90 levels so difficult, or at least give more gold to start. I almost quit, was losing more than I won. Now it's at least 1/3rd of the time I get the right cards to win. Also, why does it cost $2k to play a level and you only get like $2,045 if you win? Doesn't seem fair to me. At a further level there are events that allow us the earn money faster, should be from the start.

Expect to spend a LOT of money. I am not opposed to in game purchases but this one just burns through your gold no matter how much you buy. And the extra time with the boosters are a sham. First they are only 5-15 minutes but then all of the ads and restarting of each level and any thing that is ancillary to the game play is counted against that time. So 15 is really only 7 or 8 minutes. Just not enough upside for the money spent. Shame because it is fun.

it's fun, but the rewards you get are nothing compared to the resources you have to spend in the game. if you beat a block or lvl, you don't get nearly enough to re coop the coins you spend on a " free" card. its basically another pay big money to stay ahead or wait about. 5 hours if harvesting time ( 60 minutes ) between harvest. So it could be funner if it was more balanced.

I have played this game for a few years, and it was great. Helped fill the boredom. However, the most recent update is terrible. It keeps getting stuck loading. Loading what, I have no idea. But when you get a booster for 5 minutes and the screen is loading for at least half that time, it's hard to enjoy the game anymore. That, and something changed a few months ago making it very difficult to gain money. I'm not going to spend real world money on a game that is supposed to help relax me.

game is super fun, but has REALLY gotten to point they want you to buy things. I am over level 1700 and it's sad now game won't let you win a level. they want you to spend money on coins. I can have over 500,000 coins and spend all trying to win one level-at lowest cost. so, unless you are spending money, which I don't, you have to wait to collect enough to even play.

Money grabber I don't know who giving this a 5 star maybe it someone who willing to spend money left and right. It set up to have you spend money to get to the next game. It could be a fun game if your not stuck on the same hand ALL THE TIME. Well of course you can move to the next game if you buy buy buy. Good news though the pop up to purchase is always popping up. Who needs ads.

It's an OK solitaire game. It does seem to be a bit of a money grab. I've had multiple levels where I'm on the last card with 5 or more unused cards in my hand that are unused. This would make sense in real life using a single deck, but this is supposed to be somewhat of a strategy game. 5 card draw is also a gamble as you aren't guaranteed at least having 1 usable card match in the 5 cards.

Starting to get frustrated with the game. Past several days, have not been able to collect my daily gifts. Click on the Facebook page to get my gift? It sends me to my Google Play account for no reason. It's never done that, always gone right to the game itself. Customer support was good enough to give me Friday & Saturday's gifts, but the suggestions they gave yield no results in correcting the issue. So, once again...another day with no free gift.

Popups for purchases are way out of control. Just when you want to click on something you have to close sometimes 7 in a row. And repeats very often.Very aggravating. And bonus timers should stop while your closing them. It's not fair that the bonus 5 or 10 minute timers are still running while we have to close all these popups.

As others have said, it's a flagrant money grab game that looks like a solitaire game but has the mechanics of a slot machine, and a fixed one at that. Each hand costs you about 1,800 gold, the undo button costs 300 gold, and if you need a few more cards to try to clear, that costs you 3,000 gold. Run out of gold? That costs you real money. Way too stressful and aggravating.

Been playing for a week trying to earn some cash thru Top Survey app. I've realized that you have to pay to keep playing. The game is fun and a little relaxing but the downside is that it takes way too long between each crop grow and it costs too much to choose extra cards or the wild card to help finish the round. Already have paid around $20 to keep playing, and that's about my limit. Its too bad because I really like that that there are NO ADS at all, and there are no glitches either.

Prior to yesterday's update, this would have been 5 stars. I have been enjoying this game for months (and making micro purchases to enhance my enjoyment). However, the latest change making the "golden windmill" tool available only at the highest levels is turning this into even more of a pay to play game. The solitaire play is fine, but it's the boosters that really make this game fun, and the change to the game's best booster makes it too expensive in in-game currency to access.

I really like the game, but when I try to use the free extra cards by watching an ad, it can be frustrating...the game is interrupted and sometimes shut down and I have to open it from the start. No free anything is given! Sometimes it works, but some of these ads have no clear indication of how to quit them and there's no way to get back to the game except to restart it...with no reward!

This is a Tripeaks style solitaire game. The thing to remember about this is, at least 10% of deals are impossible to beat before you start, and many more are impossible if you don't randomly guess the correct card. This is important to note because you get very few daily attempts, which becomes infuriating. I implore you: NEVER spend a penny on this game. You will often be confronted with situations where no amount of skill will overcome a situation that requires money. Do not fall for it.

I used to love playing this game but as the prizes get lamer the prices get higher on any purchase, also super frustrating that you can't play off line anymore as it takes you to some beginners level and tells you to download your stupid level which you obviously can't do off line. I used to play it on my tablet in my car on my lunch break. now I'm back to candy crush.

The game is enjoyable until you advance far and everything costs way more to play, but your rewards do not go up proportionally to the cost of coin it costs per round, so your stash will diminish very quickly. This is a VERY greedy game. Once they know you'll pay, the algorithm will make sure you lose so that you have to keep paying to play.

game doesn't follow logic because often more than four cards of any type in the deck. game makes no sense other than to pick consecutive cards either increasing or decreasing value. at level 145 there a six aces in the deck (dealer is cheating). In some games a stupid frog sits on a card preventing it being played. Now, there's a bomb in a card, if played blows up the game and you lose.

obvious money grab. fun at first, but you won't advance without spending a lot of money. > spend 2k on a level, you only get like 2.25k for a win. Congrats! you won 250 coins, don't spend it all in one place! > can take up to 10 tries to beat one level > need to spend coins on power ups to even the odds > pop up ads all the time. save yourself time and money & download Disney solitaire instead. it's much more fun & fair compared to this rigged knock off. not getting a dime from me.

Now I love playing this game but it definitely has flaws .. My only issue with this game is how are you gonna have me spend like 11,000 coins just to win one board??? it's ridiculous! you already want (if you're playing level 1) over 2,000 coins for the regular board! like c'mon man y'all are clearly robbing people oan not too mention every coin package starts at $5-7 dollars minimum and they show you this after EVERY BOARD smh This the type of game you play for a while and then let it go.

if your playing for money through an app it's a waste level 44-46 depletes coins including the ones paid for to get through the levels. spend your money if you really enjoy playing I don't enjoy any game that much to be spending anything. there's plenty of other games where you can get through the first hundred and not deplete the free stuff that you have gotten. The amount of coins to start the levels just keep going up therefore making it almost impossible to get past level 50

so far so Great it really is a fun game... honesty I quit this game because it's geared to make you buy in or lose. at least five times I would run out of coins and because of the increase in pmt of each game it's impossible to stay ahead. it's literally a game of chance that doesn't give you a chance without money. I liked it but am on a budget and can't buy in.

AVOID THIS GAME! There is no skill or strategy to this game even if they make it out to be. You will either get a perfect hand on a level and beat it smoothly, or you waste 10k+ to best one level because you pull 5 "3" cards in a row when you need one more card to best the level. It is just luck, the powerups do very little to help. Truly terrible and very predatory micro transactions.

I have been been playing since 2021. I don't play often anymore, way too many pop-ups. When I do play, it is on x1, anymore than that and it is wasting coins. It would be nice to be able to insert the wilds or windmills ourselves, when we need them, not just put randomly by the game. Decrease the amount of pop-ups, you will lose more players in the end if you don't. No need to add your auto response, as many people have said the same thing and it doesn't change!

Well I had to come back and redo this review as I have since decided to delete my account reason being. Players please beware when playing solitaire farm, I have been having issues with my amount being added after spinning the wheel and or doing the pic 4. it does no good also to contact support as they are of no help. Of course they say their records shows differently, even after sending them proof of what you are referring too. I sent screenshots as well as screen records and yet, nothing.

Love this game. Play it daily and even have my kids play it with me. review update 4/30/26 I dont play this game as much. its been about the last year or so, that as soon as you open the app, 20 different pop up bubbles come up. you exit one, and here comes another one. I just want to be able to click a level and play without having to see pop ups for in game purchases. I understand thats how the game keeps going, but if I need to purchase something, I know where to go.

Fun but it gets harder as you progress, and the free coins aren't enough to help. The game is made to get you hooked, and then you have to buy coins to keep playing. Update. This game makes it so difficult to win the grand crop album prize. The only way to do it is to keep buying more and more credits; it's ridiculous. It seems the more you buy, the harder it gets to win.

It's a fun game, but there comes a point that you can barley win. It starts wining a lot, then just dwindles your coins even when you're winning. I was looking for a better option to Disney Solitaire and Domino Dreams, but it works the same way. It's all about the in app purchases

I love playing this game, but as others have stated, you can't get far without continually paying. For instance, a level may cost 3,700 coins. If you lose, you get a couple hundred coins. If you win, you get maybe 3,800 coins. Even using powerups, it can take 10 or more tries to pass a level. Each day, I get maybe 11,000 free coins, so I can barely play before I'm out. Bought coins don't last long, either. Too bad. It's a beautiful and fun game. Lower levels are easy to pass, at least.

1. the amount of your ad pop ups are ridiculous. They pop every single time you enter the game, it's a lot and annoying. 2. cant even play for a long period the higher the levels are. literally will be on one level for 3 days. I just randomly play a game here and there and move on with my day. its not as enjoyable as when you start. 3. the side quests are also ridiculous. accumulating 1800 gems for one little task is wild

I used to love this game. I've been playing for years. But the number and frequency of constant pop ups has made it genuinely unplayable. Open the game, close 5 pop ups wanting you to buy something. Try to collect your harvest, close 3 pop ups wanting you to buy something. Now there's a daily "visit the market" feature. It's just too much. Just make it a paid game at this point if you're going to make it impossible to play without being attacked by pop up ads every time you tap the screen.

Update: unbelievable,still no change developers Stop with the pop ups when loading game,I know where to find purchases. They don't entice,they are annoying. I like the game and mostly my team that's why I keep playing. At least minimize the pop ups for heaven sake,it'sexcessive. Also allow to have better chances meeting goals,instead of trying to reach an impossible number amount. I would give it 5 stars,perhaps update my rating when I see changes. Overall it's fun,but annoying at the same time.

A fun game with some pacing issues. Pop ups and animations between levels take an unnecessarily long time to play out. I also have to assume the game has its thumb on the scale regarding how many tries it takes to finish a level to encourage the use of pricey powerups. Make sure to set aside 10-15 minutes for a session to maximize the use of free powerups in case you get one while you play.

I have been playing thos game for years and I loved it....BUT now all it does is take my coins. I have made purchases....and they don't last long at all. This is a game I play nightly...for years...and now I find myself frustrated with it. I play for relaxation not for achievements. Losing so many games in a row(often may I add) is just ridiculous

I’ve played Solitaire Grand Harvest on and off for years and really enjoy the game. Unfortunately, it has become very difficult to progress without spending money. In my experience, the games people stick with the longest are the ones that allow players to keep playing and move forward through time and patience—not constant purchases. This will be the fourth time I’ve uninstalled the game, and sadly it will likely be the last.

it's very satisfying, for the most part. they have the opportunity to watch an ad for extra plays, and recently they get stuck and you watch it for nothing. plus the endless ads just to log in or tap on the hourly harvest. and now, they have a meaningless Indian guy in your mailbox, which doesn't add to their confidence factor. also, you can't end the game without watching the ads, and of course every thing is spying on you, so you'll get the worst ads if you're an animal lover like dog eating.

This game could be so awesome. It no longer freezes/ during play but more money you spend, more you have to spend. the algorithm challenging gameplay gets more difficult when you purchase something. up to $40. They want you to keep purchasing . It is frustrating you cannot win. you just blow through what you just purchased. it raises multiplier to get any awards. life is frustrating,you don't need this BS a money grab! try Tripeaks journey! just as fun u watch advertisements to win rewards!

Game play can be fun or frustrating. Some "hands" are set up to be unwinnable unless you use boosters or spend more coins. My major problem is the damn pop-ups with the "specials" going on...most designed to part you from your real money. When you first open the app is not great but understandable but EVERY time you leave the app without closing and then come back? EVERY time you have a limited time free booster? It wastes my time and is very annoying.

This game is a cheat! I've watched multiple ads until the end, just to be kicked out and not get my rewards. I've been playing this game almost 2 years. Fix the glitch or I'm deleting . I also dislike the time restraints versus pop-ups. Wild card 5 minutes but it's 1-2 minutes of back to back pop ups. THIS game started off as fun now it's take your money, we can care less about your experience

This game used to be an enjoyable. I've been playing it for about 4 years. but lately, it takes forever to load, several pop-up ads as soon as you open the app, and now there are video ads!! It's almost impossible to reach the goals because the prizes (when you actually win a game) are too low, therefore you can't complete the challenges.

I have played this for years and really enjoyed it. Now there are so many popup ads it's not worth my time. You have also recently added free gift buttons that only bring up ads that I can't get out of without closing all my windows. Then, when I reopen the game some of my rewards are gone. I am Uninstaller!

What's the point? This game makes no sense as far as level completion. The decks give terrible cards and an enormous amount of duplicates. Your reviews from years prior, lets me know this is what it is. It will never change. I guess it's a good time killer but don't expect any more than that. Oh, let's not forget the 1 card remaining with 8+ in the deck only to not be able to not finish the level. Trash! You play the 8× version and the winnings are so laughable.

fun, but LARGELY pay to win. you have to buy to get anywhere. you get a big bag of coins/etc and you will spend them in 1 round sometimes. what really disappoints me is that I've spent a bit in this game, i just bought the 1+10 pack for 5.99, started redeeming my free stuff, and got halfway through with an error message saying my payment wasn't successful (it literally just went through) and when I backed out and went to try again, the screen didn't even show me the 1+10 page! ripped me off!

I've played this game for almost 5 years, far and above my favorite. I've willingly spent money to play because I enjoy it. Level 40021 played at 30x to reap some benefits: all 3 power ups+ Golden windmill + three 5 extra cards, still couldn't finish the level. It cost me 8 million coins. I'm done. Not winning=not fun=not spending $ = not playing anymore when my remaining coins are gone. It's a fun game, customer support has been good when needed. It's just become too expensive for me.

Obvious cash grab. You lose your money quickly and they want you to pay to proceed. This will be the 3rd time I have deleted your game. I won't download it again. Too little recieved for what you pay out to move forward means you have to wait for the harvest to just play ONE level. I am over it. Response to editor: don't hold your breath.

Seems like the only way to beat tough levels is to spend days doing it or paying. Started out fun but now it's just annoying. Would not recommend downloading unless you like spending money. Response to dev team: This isn't about challenging levels. There is literally no way to beat them unless by random chance or spending money. I have been on the same level for a week 1 card left on the board, 7 card in my hand and not one matches what I need. Screw this. Uninstalling.

I have been playing this game for 5+ years and it didn't use to have so many pop up ads. It's become so ridiculous that I have changed my rating from 5 to just 1 star. It should NOT require a gamer to get out of the game to get out of an ad. I now only play once in 6 months or so due to that and coin allotment at the higher levels. I will probably be deleting the game soon since I don't play often enough to justify it being on my phone. It's sad really.

This is one of the most frustrating games I've played in a while. I love this type of solitaire challenge with the card order, but there is no joy in playing this. Every round you don't have a set up with the cards you need. You can pay all of your coins you earned to hope they finally give you some. I don't like the feeling of, well to pass, just buy coins and eventually you'll get the card. I get they need money, but this isn't fun.

I have been playing this game for years and truly love it. But the amount of pop-ups that I have to clear away everytime I go in to collect my hourly coins is ridiculous! It is truly making me not want to even open the app anymore. No one needs to see what sales you have every second of the day. If someone wants to buy coins they will go to the market. 5 internal adds should not have to pop up everytime I open the app to play.

I used to really love this game but recently I have been thinking about deleting it. It takes so much to play now and to get five extra cards, and the extra cheats are ridiculous. And then once you build your little farm thing it changes to another season or holiday decor so all your progress is gone. I'm sorry do better.

2026 Update: Reviewed this game for the Facebook group. After playing within the gameplay parameters, this game is awful. Countless tries on the same level. Hard to progress. It's like failing over and over. The game becomes boring since it's almost impossible to progress within reason. Unfortunately we don't recommend long term play because the game doesn't offer much without expensive buys. Pop ups galore begging for purchases gets old really fast. Spend time elsewhere, this game is boring

Great game. I like the different solitaire games. The levels are fun, some easy, some challenging. Update: The maker has released a Plus version of the game that can only be downloaded from their site. Since then, the amount of pop-ups encouraging you to download the new game is ridiculous. My phone won't allow me to add it as it's not in google play or the Samsung store. I'm seriously considering deleting the app.

I'm nearly to level 20000, so I obviously love the game. the help desk really works to get the problem solved the levels are great . it has changed since I started playing so good things some bad things but overall I really like the game. my only complaint is the amount of ads, in the beginning if you wanted more prizes you could watch an ad to get it. now to start the game you have to close 4 ads before you hit the main screen. but I stay because I love the game.

So levels 1-10 are great. fun game great solitaire it's a blast, then after lvl 20 you will start needing at least one wild every single game. then at level 30 the price of wilds doubles. you pretty much fun I into a wall that you can't get through except for if you make regular purchases. those coins run out fast when every power up costs 10,000 coins

This game is clearly rigged and so greedy. If you have a lot of coins, have a double points opportunity, have 5 windmills, the game will make you lose. You can have one card left and a whole stack of cards. Magically, none of them are right. It doesn't matter if you spend money or not, the game will force you down to zero coins quickly. I enjoy this game, but the greed is out of control.

its okay. but here's the thing. they give you a limited amount of coins, you have to pay to play the levels and the levels are not consistent in difficulty. they start out in tutorial, get difficult, then another tutorial rinsed and repeat. you also run out of money fast depending on whether you want to finish a level first try or not. had 40k coins in 4 real levels I was down to 12k. and when you play they don't include all the cards you need and instead you can get 3 of the same cards in a row

I am sad to be writing this review. This used to be my favorite game of all time! It was easy to play, and had new stuff all of the time. I'm on level 23077! It's impossible to win without real money! Most of all, they added this Plus game, all of those adds is horrible. I have been counting, you have to close out about 7 to 9 adds to play. That's not fun!

this game is a scam...it is impossible to make any progress.. it costs tokens to play each game and the rewards even on the highest multiplier are no where near the cost to play a level ....on top of that it doesn't matter how good you are there are levels that can not be beat do to missing cards and the stack of random cards you can not play.....but of course you can always buy a extra 5 pack of cards that has no cards for you to play.....I already un-installed before writing this review

Money hungry, sometimes coins not added. They offer advertising to gain something in the game. If you sign up a family member to come play on Facebook and they join, you can't play together on the same team. They bombard you with 3 to 4 purchases. Also. if you play free from 7 to 8 .months they give you an ultimatum, make a purchase or down grade. If you down grade, then you lose your level! It used to be a fun and great game but not any more!

its a really fun game, I liked it because it didnt have ads but now they've started throw in some optional ones, which is fine. I really dont like how little money you get from things though. every hour you can get enough coin to play one level. the extra goodies you can get for winning a level has become increasingly pitiful. used to be pretty decent winnings. the only way you can play the higher multiplier levels, is if you spend money because you'll never earn enough to get the amount needed

the cheese rally race game is horrible. I'm not playing this until you get rid of this game. time consuming and I don't get the option to exit out without restarting the app. the payouts is horrible also. why spend over 3mil coins onl a level to lose and only get back 67k. horrible all the way around. I've been playing this game for 8 years and this is the worst. I thought games got better. and the prices are just ridiculous to purchase anything

I have been playing this game for years and I liked it a lot - until they started shoving their PLUS app (that isn't in the play store) down our throats. One ad about it per session would be fine, but I'm seeing three in a row, stopping me from playing and running out the timers on my boosts. The popups were already disruptive enough. *edit: Devs hope I keep playing after this? I deleted the game right after I posted this review.*

I like the game itself and the different variations of solitaire you can play. However, there is way too many pop ups when first opening the app and in-between games. I understand pop ups for in app purchases of extra coins or bonuses but it's almost between every single game. While I like the game the annoying pop ups decreases my play time and often consider deleting the app.

it's fun to play. but costs tooo much in coins to continue playing. plus a negative reaction in the end of nearly every stage or level after number 10. I definitely don't recommend this game is you don't plan on smashing your device because your out of coins to continue playing and you obviously can't finish the level with zero credits.

I love this game. My recommendation would be to cut back on the amount of tokens needed for wild cards, boosters, etc...way, way, way too much, and don't even talk about the expense if you're playing on the second or third levels. Also, is there some way the player can see in the opening (where the boosters are located) what type of level it is we're playing; for for example is it an acorn level, is it a spider level, is it the lily pad with the frog, etc. Thank you for an exciting game.

I love the game and play daily. The downside is at least once a week I run out of levels and have to play in the master's tournament. I hate the master's tournament! There is no option to spin the wheel or to harvest new crops. Therefore you really never bump up your payouts. If the developers cannot come up with more than a few days worth of more levels at a time, I am going to uninstall the game and find something else to play.

The game started off great. With time, this game grew unrealistically more challenging. And, the game difficulty wouldn't be so much of a problem if it weren't so hard to gain coins to win higher levels (even with the daily rewards from social media). I've decided to uninstall. The game is no longer convenient or enjoyable. I will either be on a hot streak for a day or two or lose every game for weeks. What's the point? Just another money grab masquerading as a "free" game #gmab.

Fun game, but obviously a money-grab... You barely make anything when you win, so when you get to more difficult levels, you can't afford to try more than once or twice. At best, you can check in several times to collect your harvest to earn money, but that's difficult when you work full time. I likely uninstall once my money runs out again. I don't mind spending money on an app for the extras, but I don't like being forced. Update: Due to the condescending response, I have since deleted it.

I've been playing this game for about a year or longer. I loved playing it for being challenging, and fun. Now, it's getting to the point that is ridiculous to pass a level. Also, I used to be able to watch an ad to get double the coins , but for some reason that has been taken away. I rarely get grand album cards now. For the dice, now is really hard to earn dice. Every change that was made for this game just made it frustrating and not fun at all.

I'm at level 11814 now, and as others have said, when I save up my credits, I am set up to fail. It only gives you credits every hour. It's ridiculous that you are set to play only once an hour, unless you pay. Since the last update, your efforts in the pyramid challenges no longer contribute to the daily missions, which is frustrating. This game only wants your money.

I originally gave it 4* but I have recently changed it to 1* now because of the updates and changes. Now if you aren't spending money then you can forget about much progress at all on this game. They want you to play at higher levels to win the extra events. But you can't afford it. And even if you can, they don't let you win very often. It just eats up your money. I don't recommend this game unless they change it back to the old way where they aren't rigging it

A spin on solitaire...fun and never boring. However, once you get up to the higher levels (500+) it is costing me 3.2k per game, and they are nearly impossible to win. It might take me 25 or more times of trying a particular level to win, and that's way too much money. Sometimes it takes longer than that, too. So, as fun as this game was in the beginning, the higher levels are just irritating and therefore I will probably be deleting this game soon. What a pity.

The game sets you up to fail so that you use real money to get through the levels. Plus, at times, you don't get the full amount of coins. Also, the levels are so expensive now I can only play one level a day on average. The visuals are great and the dog is cute. But, I'd rather be able to sit for a few minutes and actually play the game. ***UPDATE*** Went ahead and Uninstalled the game and found another very similar instead that isn't a money grab.

Great game, but horribly expensive to play. The more you progress, the more it costs to play...but the return on investment to clear the boards are stagnant. Meaning, the cost goes up with difficulty,but they payouts doesn't mot increase at the same rate. I would NOT recommend this game based on the sheer cost to play it.

I am very upset with this game, when I started playing ( over 2 years ago) the game play was fun, challenging and at times could even be relaxing. Now if you are not willing to buy the in game credits you will not get anywhere, I have been stuck on the same level for over 2 weeks! So it is time to say goodbye to the stressful money pit grand harvest has become!

A quite Enjoyable Tri Peaks Solitaire offering. Beautiful colorful graphics. Coins run out to quickly tho. As the winnings, so far, are always less than it costs to play each round. So, it's not a game you can play at much length, unless you're prepared to spend money. Log in to harvest wherever you think of it, and don't forget to pet the dog!! He will give you coins. You can do it several times before he needs a nap. LoL Every little bit helps!

Seemed pretty good at first. The harder the levels, the more coins you must spend. It is now getting to be crazy stupid expensive to keep up with playing the levels now. I am past level 80 and am having a hard time being able to justify the cost to play vs the amount you can collect in the time frames given until harvesting. As you progress.... the levels cost increase drastically and so do the Bonus Boosters needed in many of the levels to progress or collect enough prizes - coins - gems - dice etc. for other missions. Also on another note, I have tried multiple times to connect my bank card and PayPal to pay for extras to pass levels such as Peggy's Savings. I am at over 68,000 coins in savings with Peggy for $2.99 and cannot buy them. I have gotten ahold of support of which have given me direction on how to add and process payments - which I have done in the past with other Games. It won't work. I cannot connect this game to my FB page , even though it says that I am connected. I believe I am supposed to receive coins for connecting with my FB account and I am not connected. I cannot pull this game up on my laptop via FB. I do not recall receiving promised coins. :-( Again... another sad and frustrating moment. Want to keep game for a bit longer but it is getting to that point that I will just uninstall and forget about it. What is the point of trying to advance in a game where you really have not a chance?? That is not fun nor challenging or rewarding. Disappointing, yes.

This game could be so good! There's not much ads. But the problem is on every level, to play it you have to use 1,000+ coins. And in the levels if you wanna undo a move you made, it cost 600. Basically forcing you to buy coins or wait an hour to harvest crops and get about 2,000 coins. So it takes a long time to progress in levels.

Great game, and I loved playing it! But you pay 10,000 coins for a game and only won 1,000ish back... but if you lose, you lose all 10,000 coins.... therefore, getting ahead in this game was not really possible. I played 1 stage 5 times to finally beat it and win 2,008 coins... but I lost over 50,000 coins in the process. So, as much as I enjoyed it sadly I'm done playing it.

This game of solitaire is fun and challenging but it's also pricey. As others have stated if you play a lot you'll lose all of your gold. Ironically it'll say you won with the crowd cheering, yet you have less and less gold. What I do is I go into harvest mode. I'll log in long enough to harvest and maybe roll the dice and then log out. I literally stop playing for awhile and focus on harvest to add gold. Once I have plenty, I play again. Not a perfect process, but at least it's free.

I love this game. I play daily. Also no ads! However, it is challenging after the first 200 levels or so. You have to be patient. I have played over 11k levels and have enough coin to play whenever I want. I haven't spent any real money. Some levels took days, but it is possible without paying. Definitely recommend if you have the patience to build your coins up slowly!

I absolutely love this game, it is fun but WAY too expensive to play. It seems as soon as you get up a stockpile of coins, the levels are unbeatable until you get down to needing to buy more coins or waiting to harvest more. Thinking about getting rid of this game before I spend my grocery money on coins lol. Bottom line, fun but WAY too expensive . Wow, just turned it on to play and I lost 100,000 somewhere! Definitely getting rid of this game. That's BS!?

Basically, my review is the same as most. The game is fun, though the card patterns repeat too frequent. I've never played a game that has cost me more credits to play than I win. Even on "well," you should at least get 4,900 credits it cost to play. The games are set to win when they want to. Getting stuck on levels for long periods of time does not make for a fun time. If the goal is to have the consumer make in-app purchases, then don't make it a free app.

The harvest bonus used to mean something. But 11.5k an hour when it costs 96k to play a round (win or lose) isn't much of a bonus. If you don't score a perfect game, you lose by playing. There is no way to get ahead once you reach a certain level. The "prize" for completing crops isn't worth going back to try and up your star count. I agree with others that it used to be a fun game. Now it's all about how much they can snag out of your wallet.

Appears to be programmed so that the player constantly goes in the hole and never comes out ahead, much like slot machine games. Also, when one receives free cards, most of them go right in the play that is next, that way the programmers can be sure that "good" cards are not provided in this manner. Hey programmers, at least give the player a 50-50 chance.

Fine as a game itself, but there have been multiple times when you literally can not win without spending money or using a bunch of power ups. An instance of that happened on a game with the lock where you have to play colors to unlock it. I had to no cards I could play that were drawn or in play. So again, nice enough waste of time, but not spending money in a game where it will just decide I lose.

Used to love this game. It is impossible to advance without paying ridiculous amounts of real money, and I've paid. Only to later be charged more coins per time trying a level, on level 6,150 now. The highest setting used to cost like 31k coins, and now the highest setting costs 114k. Then the "prizes" at the end of each crop aren't even enough to play a round on the highest setting. Greed is a killer. You had a great product that was fun and challenging, not anymore. Time to uninstall.

I love the game but every time I exit the game and come back a few hours later I have to log back in and it takes several times to do so, the event with using the gems is not showing up any longer in the game, everything is working fine with all devices I play on & internet is as well. Going to have to change my rating until things can be fixed.

I've been playing this game for years. I'm on level 7100. It's a fun game. After the most recent update, I have found it freezes way too much and there's so many pop ups. My mom plays this game too and she's level 4000. Sometimes the mini games give her more money than me and vice versa. I guess there is no rhyme or reason to things. We both have spent so much money just buying the add ons to be able to get gems/dice etc.

Impossible to get enough coins to keep playing. The more levels you make it to. The less coins you get to be able to play. This game isn't balanced. Then when you get a 'Free" play card. They "discount" the coins by only a couple of thousands of coins. Im beginning to get frustrated playing. It's almost impossible to make the challenge goals as well, to earn more coins. I'm contemplating deleting this if it doesn't get fixed.

8/19/22 A year later and its doing it again. I send in notices over and over but no reply back. Screens are black can't see the cards to play. Any bonus games are note getting done. Respond to me. It used to be fun to play now nothing works. Loaded game twice but unable to play any cards. Game went off reloaded did the same thing. Lost 2 rounds of play and the money amount too. I'm getting ready to uninstall. I have written to the help desk twice. Nothing has changed.

I remember downloading this game in the beginning of the year and instantly fell in love w the levels and design. After many months I decided to reinstall it and was saddened at how money hungry it became. The add ons of gems, hunts, even a mini farm(?!), &absurdly expensive levels has shown me that they don't want to make a game but a money machine. It's like I *have* to spend money or wait half the day to aquire enough coins to play one game. I still enjoy the concept and hope they will change

At first I really liked this game, and I don't mind paying a little for upgrading a game (I know it takes money to run a game w/ no ads)- but this is not that game. It's a never ending money pit, even if you save up your rewards by getting the hourly reward- eventually the game gets so difficult that all power ups, 5+ cards, and wild cards in the world won't move you on. You have to pay for rewards that are used up within days, and then your encouraged to repeat and repeat the process again.

This game is super fun... however, you can only play the first few levels until this "free" game becomes nearly impossible to play for free. You get a set amount of coins, and then have to pay to play each level. The amount increases ever level, and you wind up spending more coins than you make. If you want to play a few rounds and pay out of pocket it's great, for everyone else its ridiculous

I have been playing this game for a while now. The more I play the more I see going wrong. For instance, the game stalled. I had accumulated 960 out of 1000 gems needed for 100 points. When I was able to get back into the game, the 960 was 0 zero. This was very frustrating as it took some time to get there. You have just started this delaying the start of missions in the My Trail segment of the game. WHY? There's no reason to except to cut time the player could use to work on gold ticket rewards

Recently the coins required to progress to new levels in the "seasons" has doubled. I understand that you want to be profitable however this appears to be ridiculous greed. Without buying coins on a daily (sometimes more than once a day) basis, I can play one game each hour. I have really enjoyed playing this game over the past few years but it's not fun anymore.

Too greedy. This is a fun game, but as with too many of these they're all about you buying. You get too few coins to play more than a hand or two if you lose. The events are almost impossible to make progress on if you don't play their higher mode which requires a lot more coins. Basically if you want to play much you would have to pay daily- and many aren't cheap, like $10 for their weekly event. If they made it more reasonable I'd be happy to pay once in a while. As it is, it's unplayable

I'm updating my original review. While there's still glitches with the game, which is to be expected. My biggest complaint is that while I initially enjoyed the game, I no longer do because after you reach a higher level, you can only advance by paying. It costs a lot more tokens to play and you don't get enough in the hourly harvest to play a game, even if you sat and played all day. They don't give the bonus harvest anymore. Sadly I'm out over $1,000, in just a few short months.

***update. EVERY SINGLE TIME theres a new event it takes forever to get game to load. Last time took 2 days to get to play. I have cleared cache and attempted to load 11 times in last 4 hours but all I get is "loading" Too many glitches! Since updating the app will no longer fully load. It sits there saying it's loading but nothing. It was a fun game but in past couple of weeks I have spent more time waiting for game to load than actually playing.

I love to play this game but as usual it's starting NOT to be inexpensive. Its takes an hour to re-generate more credits which makes it a slow game. And now you can get more credits, (Peggy the Pig) but of course, you must pay for them! It gets so expensive just for basically, Solitaire. I do enjoy the game, but when we were supposed to get free credits when the Pig started out, I didn't get any. I don't know why but I think I closed it out too fast. Anyway, thanks for letting me rant!!

The game itself is cool, but rigged to force you to purchase coins if you want to play more than 1 or 2 rounds per hour. If you have a life and a job and want to sleep at night, you can't harvest your crops hourly. As you progress the cost becomes exhorbitant but the reward does not increase. This is not a game that you can play to relax after a hard day at work. I haven't uninstalled it yet, but I'm very close.....Update: I finally had enough and uninstalled. Free at last....

I really love this game!! It's addictive, and a great time killer (if u have the money). But when u run out of money and don't have real money to spend to keep playing, it SUCKS!! Every hour I harvest just enough to play ONE TIME .. Then wait a hour for another try!! It would be my favorite game if they just gave me more money, or the boards were cheaper, or a way to get money for watching a videos. Just something!!!

It is a fun game. But very heavy for pay to play. And when can't win unless u pay. And the creaters keep saying come every hour which I do but still get stuck for a week on 1 level. And the package only last 5 to 6 days which is short time for $9.99 . Wish they can make improvements. I've tried all the free ability available. Still is a pay to play game. And I'm sure the creators will probably put the same message they tell everyone that leaves a rating. Which is sad. Instead of improving.

I played this game for over a year but I'm finally breaking free from it...I gave it 2 stars because I did enjoy it in the beginning. Here's the problem: It is definitely fixed to where it's extremely hard to play without paying. I got where I would just collect coins for a month straight without even playing. Even then, I was unable to complete events fully due to the lose/win ratio... It can also be slow at times with lots of pop ups every time you open the game...

I would describe this game as one word, frustrating. It's heavily advertised and suggested as a free game. It is free to download but it is not free to play. If you do play without buying tokens, you're going to be very disappointed. In the beginning my harvest were 3 to 4 thousand but now I harvest a little over 2 thousand. It takes me days to save enough tokens to play and then waste them all on one card game often not winning for lack of tokens. When I do win I get little reward.

I loved it at first, but to play takes so many coins with barely any profit made after winning a level. Why is it so expensive to play, or get 5 extra cards?! And all the cookies you have to feed a pet to level it up x5! I never get to keep the pets. It takes thousands of cookies to level up. No one has time for that! It's ridiculous! Quit being money greedy and make the game fun without having to go broke to play it! I'm very close to just uninstalling.

They make it look like if you sign up with facebook that you'll get 10,000 credits but then don't. Very misleading. Unsynced my facebook immediately. Also, once you get to a certain point in the game it's almost impossible to play without paying. I don't mind spending money on a game I enjoy. I HATE & refuse however, to spend money on apps that try to manipulate you into paying.

I loved this game until I became really high in level, now I'm about to delete it. It becomes very hard to beat the levels, you'll be stuck playing the same level over and over and at the lowest amount to be played. It doesn't give much play time, your little bonus every hour covers 1 deal at the lowest level, so trying to advance in other areas of the game is almost nil. Disappointing!

Stay away from this app. While the game is fun, the support is horrible and the engineers worse. Game crashes or freezes about every 10 minutes. Emailed with support for over 2 months and all they do is recite the same lines over and over- "We know about the issue. Our engineers are working on it". They'll throw some free credits your way, but it's about a tenth of what you lose all the times that the game crashes.

I have been playing this game for months now and absolutely loved it. But the last couple weeks have been horrible. It keeps freezing and backing me out. At the moment it's only 7100 coins for me to play. I bought coins and had to spend over 100,000 just to beat one level. I finally got to a blue crate after spending the rest of my coins but it kicked me out showing I didn't beat the level. It's super frustrating. And I'm over it. I won't be playing this game anymore.

Game constanly crashes when you finally about to pass a level, when the send error report pops up, that crashes also. Everytime it does crash you lose the coins it cost to play the level. Dont pay for anything in the game, cause you will lose your coins and the money you spent on them to play. Used to be fun. But you dont get much back when you pass a level, its now designed to get people to pay to play, or take the coins you do have from passing a level.

This game is so much fun. It has cute graphics with the dog barking out coins when you tap him. The PROBLEM is that there are not enough coins to play the game. I spend the day trying to build up my coins every hour, so that I can play "1 single game". Then, I'm down to no coins and have to build up again to play "1 single game" the following day. Annoying! Please let me know if you change the game structure. I will be deleting the game right now.

So it has a lot of potential to be a really fun and enjoyable game...but they set it up so you HAVE TO purchase coins/credits to keep playing. Even on a win streak, you still lose coins and you can barely get a good 10-15 minutes in of enjoying this game. It's so annoying and very scam like...I'm not one of those people that like to purchase game credits. So I'll try to find another game to enjoy. It sucks because this is one of the most unique games I have come across in a long time..

What a complete let down. If you want to never get ahead or spent money that won't really do much for you. This is the game. Talk about all about the money. This game is a complete joke. When you can't even win enough coins from the level you just payed to play unless you spend money or wait an hour or so. Then here the game for you. Huge let down won't be telling anyone to try but the opposite. No stars from me. The idea very good. Actual playing well obviously there all about the money.

8/18/22: updating my review, fun game, I actually spend money for coins, but the higher your level the more coins it costs to play! And if you do good you barely get your play back! it's getting too much! it's a fun game but not worth the coins, and when you hit big achievements I feel like your play is harder thus losing your coins faster! you can collect coins every hour but only 4800 every hour. one round is like 18000!(if you watch an add, you get a discount for 15 min so much fun! love it!

I would say about a 2.5 out of 5. Start out easy with lots of money, then prices go up, get maybe a hundred coins for winning a level if that, some times more, not common though. Lose and you're out 20 times what you win. Ok, so collect coins every hour, to get enough to play once. Not really a convenient game to play if you have to make sure to collect every hour just to play once even when there is no possibility to win some levels. It is simply a cash grab from a greedy developer.

Just started playing today, but it seems to be a pretty good game of solitaire. I also like the fact that buying extra cards with your coins doesn't cost a fortune like other games that I've played. So I'd rate the game overall at strong 4 stars. **2/17/2020** I downloaded the game again about 3 wks ago, & it's still one of the better Solitare games. I still feel the cost of in-app purchases is reasonable, & they've even added a few extras to help you win $$ or power-ups. 4 Stars!!!

OMG, the new "look" of the farm is AWFUL, it looks so cluttered and way too many icons around the page. How about when you are going to try something different with the game send a trial for a couple of says to see if people like it. This is my favorite game, however, it is expensive, full of ads, and now Welcome to Cluttered Up Farm. I am in the market for a new solitaire game.

This app was so much fun at first. But as I climbed in levels the game started giving me less stars per round and less money for completing. I even tried to save up a lot of money to play more games at once and it seems like the more money you have the faster you spend it. Your telling me that I had 15,000 points and only was able to play 3 times???? when it cost 2.9k a game?.. make it make sense... I have finally had enough and I uninstalled.. I don't like apps that cheat!!

I like the app a lot but the cost of the rounds is way to high. 1500 coins is way way to high I bought a new phone and grand Harvest didn't find me so they started me back to level 1. I purchased several pks as well. I was in the 1000s on levels. The above was my the first opinion of the game and I had given it 4 stars. Needless to say I was mad because they couldn't find me in their records.

came back to edit my review. I do love this game and would love to play for hours! Due to the fact that the levels are getting more expensive and the wild cards are not even possible to use because of the amount of coins needed. As it is I can only play a few games, harvest several times only to be able to play a few more rounds. Being on a limited income I cant purchase coins. Please increase coins for harvest and daily bonuses, and lower the cost for wild cards. I'm not the only one complaining

A lot of fun but too much pay to play. Too expensive after you reach the higher levels. While you get free credits every hour, they're less than half what's needed for a single game. The "free game" cards are misleading as in higher levels they're worth a third of the game cost. I've been playing a year. Sorry to say I won't be playing any longer

Soooo I am a first time player and only have had the app no longer than a month and already can see issues. The game freezes, you don't always get the prizes that you win, and what I'm dealing with now is it won't allow me to make any in app purchases in the shop due to game still processing payment from days ago. I have contacted support, sent screenshots, but I have lost out on the game events and the games shop perks due to the issues. Really sucks!

Great game, loads of fun. I would have given it 5 stars but they limit your play time by making everything so expensive. To use a wild card during play, it costs what you would be able to play 3 more rounds. So usually I get to play 2 or 3 rounds then I can't play anymore until I make more money harvesting the crops, otherwise I could sit and play for hours.

I'm at level 12995, I have not been able to play all week, and now the puzzle game is ending, so will not receive any of the bonuses. I have been playing for a long time now, and since the latest update, the game crashes, you lose coins and extra items. When you submit a ticket, all you get is an automated response. So tired of the B.S. and no solutions to the problems.

Fun way to kill time if it doesn't kill your bank account first. It's great in the beginning when you have a huge stash of coins and the task to earn more are simple. I know the challenge of winning a level is what makes something enjoyable but when it cost more to play a level than your harvest is and you are also going to need to purchase power ups to complete the level, you may get to play 2 or 3 a day if you're lucky. You can consider yourself lucky if you come anywhere close to even.

I played this game for a few days, everything worked fine.... then, all of a sudden, today the game is freezing & I can't get past the "Daily Goodies" screen. Now I have over 200,000 credits that I can't use. I've noticed a few other people complaining about the game freezing... if this glitch cannot be fixed, the game shouldn't be available to install. Also, fair warning... after level 100, be prepared to spend lots of credits to continue progress. Btw credits will cost you cash or you'll spend a lot of time waiting & checking for "harvest" to gain a few credits.

I truly don't recommend downloading this game. I love solitaire, don't get me wrong, but this game wants you to spend money. Everything you spend coins on is priced WAY to high. Buying powerups?? Good luck. Need help on a level, forget about it. Unless you want to spend $20 for 30k coins each time you run out, be my guest. If this game was made to truly enjoy, I wouldn't have an issue with anything. but the developers made this game as a money maker. Don't waste your time on this game.

Frustrating as many others have opined. This is ridiculous that you can't move forward more than once in a span of hours and in some cases, days. I'm not buying any of the offers for more points, coins, whatever as you go through them faster than the time taken to make the purchase. It is a money (and time and patience) grab and I think it's time to uninstall this game.

Finally finished with this game. The additional add-on games that are supposed to add to the game have become ridiculous. Cannot even earn enough coins or stars to finish without paying. It's no longer fun but aggravating! Have always enjoyed this game until recently. It has become more about spending money than the enjoyment of the game. So disappointing 😞 These supposed improvements are more distracting. One thing at a time always worked in the past. No longer happy at all with this game.

Still Stuff is so expensive on the game and to play you start out a thousand coins and when you get to around level thirty or before it's costing twenty thousand or more the boosters are more expensive then the game! Don't get me wrong but I have paid alot of money to play this game and I love it but it would be nice to still have money left when the game is over it took me about one hour to spend twenty dollars and that's no bull; And by no means I'm not rich! Well I appreciate your opinion too

I absolutely love the game solitaire. But this game cost so much game money for each level. I am on level 65. Anyone who plays games knows that not many and i have been playing for over a week. But you have to harvest in order to get game money and you only get enough to play one round. Why not be able to play five rounds, ut isnt like were going to beat the level, because even that takes a long time.

Edited: 24March, 2023 I decided to try one more time to play this game, since I read you could "build your own farm" . Love playing, but I have been robbed of many coins. If you want to play, I hope you have a lot of money. The further you get into the game, the harder it gets and at almost 30,000 coins to play a game... it eats them fast!!!! And don't bother trying to email them when you have a problem with the game when they rob you of your earnings... their website won't let you due to not being able to enter a subject!!!

Game is alot of fun but the higher levels the more it cost. The coins you recieve every hour (which is to long to wait) is not even enough to play next level on higher levels. This game is alot of fun but get ready to either wait to play or get out your cash when you reach higher levels. I am playing on level 4000+ and can only play a few times each day because now it cost so many coins to play each time. Why cannot you leave ea. game the same cost no matter what level ? Other games do this .

Would not recommend it to anyone over 5. Even if you can get past the fact that it constantly begs you for money, even just trying to play it is difficult with the cascade of slowly animated, repetitive popups. It will actively refuse to let you do anything but sit through these promos of current events, even if you JUST want to play the game. The gameplay itself is fine, though the fact that you are so often stuck with a stockpile of cards that do nothing can suck. Also, I don't like the pig.

The game was fun at the beginning. However, the more you win, the more you lose. The multiplier works well but when adding the credits, the tax man gets his first. You will only get full credits at the 1x multiplier. In this universe, 0+7 is never equal to 5. Maybe it's the new math. I have been ripped off and it's been at least several hundred thousand credits. Not a good way to keep customers. 😕

Game is impossible to play without purchasing coins. I believe this is unfair. No other options or ad watching is available. There is an hourly "harvest" that, as far as I have gotten, will give you enough for access to one attempt. But, lose that game, and it's another hour just to try once more. Other reviews I've read state that higher levels cost more than the harvest amount. Meaning even longer waits just to make one attempt. But, if you want to be forced to pay, have fun.

I've waited to make my review. I enjoy the game. I have fun on the regular sessions. Every hour you can harvest for credits. Plus every 3 hr petting Sam will give you an add'l an gift😃. If your patient you can increase your credits. I've only purchased credits twice. I had a problem with one purchase. They fixed it immediately plus they gave credits for my troubles. Now yes, each session is expensive. But again as I said w/ patients you can play w/o purchase. I will change my stars after that.

The game was okay until all the tokens that you've earned to try to buy coins, They started disappearing and so did the rubies. You earned tokens and rubies to try to buy more coins to play the game. It's like the game was taking them away It happened several times and I never really got a decent response. I got teed off and also in one area under the presents area they would raise the price to buy these presents from the last time. started taking pic Make sure I wasn't making a mistake. Unista

An enjoyable game to begin with, but would be a lot better if two things were different. 1: the higher you go the bigger hike in coins levels demand, often you can only make maybe 1 attempt level every few hours which slows progress massively. 2: After a streak of a few levels the game seems to be designed to deliberately make you fail. 5,6,7 card flips in a row without a single match? Come on guys! Sometimes you can go through several cards before you're even able to make the first move!

I have been playing for quite some time (almost level 800) but I too will be done playing soon as this game is designed to only force you to purchase coins. The amount of coins it takes to play a level even at the smallest volume is absurd. By the time you use your coins to play a level and win your gain in coins is little to none. This game is super frustrating because it's actually a lot of fun to play for a game that just advertises itself as Solitaire, but I can't actually play it because the in-game economy makes absolutely no sense. Unless you win every single level on the very first try, you're going to end up with a net loss in coins, and when you win, you get maybe 20% more coins than what you put in just to play the level, which means that only every 5 levels you complete first try, in a row, will you actually get enough coins to play an extra level. It doesn't matter how many crops you plant because as you progress, everything you pay for scales up in price as well (level entry fee and bonuses), so in the end the net difference between what you earn and what you spend stays the same (it might actually get worse since each crop only gives you an additional 50 coins per HOUR, but the cost to play increases by like 500 coins every field; I'm only at around level 80 so I can't say for sure). Playing the bonus levels that increase your crop yield is also pointless because you have to play through 15 expensive levels that have extra challenges, and in the end all you get is 10 extra coins, again, per hour. When it costs 2000 coins just to play one level, 10 coins is completely useless. As mentioned, the only way you really get coins is from a harvest, where you essentially earn about 125% of what it costs just to play a level, give or take depending on how far you are. Other than that, the only way to get any significant amount of coins is to pay real money for it. I bought the $2.99 first time bonus, and was happy to do it because gameplay wise this is a really fun game, which gave me 45,000 coins, but I blew through it in a day, because if you lose a level even once or try to use any of the abilities, you're basically screwed. Even the options to harass your friends with game invites over various social media platforms don't give you any significant amount of coins. It's a real shame. I could sit and play this game for hours but I'm limited to 2-3 levels at a time tops assuming I've opened the app every single hour right at the hour to harvest my mediocre amount of coins. You need to fix this economy. Follow the Candy Crush model if you have to: harvest every 20 minutes at most, and I shouldn't have to open the app every single time to do it (cap auto harvests at 5). There should be other ways to earn coins too. One positive of your game is you have never made me watch an ad, but I'd rather have the option to watch an ad and earn at least one level's worth of coins so I can actually play your game. Add a daily bonus wheel or something too. Or ignore these suggestions and just fix your economy. Level entry fee shouldn't scale as I build my farm. Level 1 should cost the same to play as level 80, and same with the in game bonuses (wild card, +5 cards, etc). Also, the extra levels that "increase the yield", they should at least double my yield, not just add 10. I don't write many reviews but I really like playing your game, and I really want you to fix it so I can continue to do so. It's not worth spending real money on coins when they don't get you anywhere.

The levels have become impossible - so much so that you may have to play a level (at full cost each time) 5 - 10 times at least to actually pass. The payback for winning a level does not give enough for you to build a pot for continuous play so you find that you can only play a couple of levels before you are waiting for credits to refill. Show me anybody that has time to get the "free" refill on the hour all day long!!! Ridiculous - there are far better free to play games out there that do not rely on you putting your hand in your pocket to be able to actually play for a reasonable length of time. The other major frustration is that this developer is way behind its players - constantly waiting for new levels to be released and when they are they only release 75 at a time. Been waiting since 17th March since the last release and still no site of new levels. All of this at the same time that you are supposed to be growing your farm to win bigger prizes - well you cant build a farm when there are no new levels to play past level 7991. They will of course insist that you can play "Master League" but these games are even more impossible than the normal levels in the game. Shame this game has had to be ruined out of greed as it used to be great. You would have thought that players who were willing to watch ads all day long if they could to get credits to be able to play should have been enough - clearly not!!! Very unhappy and would have given it no stars now if I could.
